scheme_name: Silicosis Rehabilitation Pension- Haryana Silicosis Board
other_conditions: Worker must be confirmed to suffer from Silicosis by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana
Worker must be classified as category A, B, or C according to the ILO Classification
Worker must be registered with the Haryana Silicosis Board
Worker must have been employed in a factory or at a construction site
benefits_summary: A monthly pension of ₹4,000 is provided to eligible silicosis‑affected workers until death.
documents_required: Certificate of being a widow/widower or nominee (if applicable)
